title: AI-based rock strength assessment from tunnel face images using hybrid neural networks
summary: A hybrid neural model assessed tunnel-face images against lithology, weathering, and rock-strength measurements in the studied engineering samples. The result is limited to the tested engineering samples and measurements; field-scale performance was not established.
ai_technology: Hybrid neural-network assessment of tunnel-face images
organization: School of Civil Engineering, Xi'an University of Architecture and Technology, Xi'an, 710055, China

evidence.tested: A hybrid neural model assessed tunnel-face images against lithology, weathering, and rock-strength measurements in the studied engineering samples. The result is limited to the tested engineering samples and measurements; field-scale performance was not established.
evidence.unknown: The model was evaluated on the study’s engineering samples and measurements; performance on other tunnel geology, at field scale, or in construction decisions was not established.
